fichas.title: Restaurant and dining-room layouts
fichas.summary: Illustrated dining-room arrangements compare table sizes, seating capacities, and circulation for restaurants, self-service restaurants, and bistro-café-bars. Space needs vary by restaurant type; diagonal table arrangements can save up to 35% compared with aligned layouts. Room dimensions should be developed from specific furniture layouts rather than capacity-per-area formulas. The text recommends service stations for each group of 40 places and organizing tables into appropriately sized groups.
